name: io.github.rhel-lightspeed/linux-mcp-server
description: MCP server for read-only Linux system administration, diagnostics, and troubleshooting

environmentVariables.name: LINUX_MCP_VERIFY_HOST_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: Verify remote host identity via known_hosts

environmentVariables.name: LINUX_MCP_HOST_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Where tools may run: `local-only`, `remote-only`, or `any` (default: `remote-only` in a container or on a non-Linux platform, otherwise `any`)

environmentVariables.name: LINUX_MCP_LOG_OUTPUT
environmentVariables.description: Log destination: files (default, rotating text and JSON files plus text stderr), stdout (HTTP transports only), or stderr

environmentVariables.name: LINUX_MCP_LOG_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: Stream log format: text (default) or json; ignored in files mode

environmentVariables.name: LINUX_MCP_LOG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Server log directory (used only with LINUX_MCP_LOG_OUTPUT=files)

environmentVariables.name: LINUX_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: default, DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL. default is INFO and above for linux-mcp-server itself, but WARNING and above for libraries it uses.

environmentVariables.name: LINUX_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
environmentVariables.description: Days to keep log files (default: 10; used only with LINUX_MCP_LOG_OUTPUT=files)
